result.title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
result.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
result.summary: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

AI.brief_summary: HWRE-Bench 是面向 LLM agent 的硬件逆向工程基准：按前向设计流程各环节丢弃的信息（命名、层次、字级结构、生成参数、编程模型）划分信息丢失层级与五类任务，并要求 agent 用可执行交付物证明恢复出的功能，另设必须得零分的「复制网表」控制任务；论文报告了两智能体、148 条轨迹的试点结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信息丢失层级 + 强制零分控制 + 分阶段标注轨迹」的评测装置，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否真正保留并使用任务必要信息、以及通过率是否能代表理解，而非仅凭等价或分数判断；迁移属推测。
